# agents { #mlsysim.agents }

`agents`

Authoritative registry of agent system profiles, Volume III lighthouse workloads (`Research`, `Remediation`, `Support`), execution harnesses, and reference platforms.

## Classes & Registries

| Object | Type | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| [`Agents`](#mlsysim.agents.Agents) | `Registry` | Root registry grouping all agent namespaces (`Coding`, `Research`, `Remediation`, `Support`, `Deliberation`, `MultiAgent`, `Interactive`, `Platforms`). |
| [`AgentPlatforms`](#mlsysim.agents.AgentPlatforms) | `ReferencePlatforms` | Canonical reference platforms binding compute nodes, models, and sandboxes. |
| [`AgentArchitecture`](#mlsysim.agents.AgentArchitecture) | `BaseModel` | Typed schema for agent execution harnesses, context boundaries, and sandbox metrics. |
| [`ResearchWorkload`](#mlsysim.agents.ResearchWorkload) | `AgentWorkload` | Typed schema for fan-out orchestrator-worker research workloads over untrusted external sources. |
| [`RemediationWorkload`](#mlsysim.agents.RemediationWorkload) | `AgentWorkload` | Typed schema for on-call production remediation workloads with human approval gates and canary checks. |
| [`SupportWorkload`](#mlsysim.agents.SupportWorkload) | `AgentWorkload` | Typed schema for interactive customer-support workloads with shared prefix caching and latency deadlines. |

## Sub-Registries

### `Agents.Coding`
- `SWE_Bench_Runner`: Reference SWE-bench coding harness hosted on `Systems.Nodes.HGX_H100_EPYC` with Firecracker microVM sandboxing (5 ms startup, 15 ms snapshot restore, 512 MiB footprint, 30 max steps).
- `SWE_Bench_Workstation`: Local unified-memory developer baseline hosted on `Systems.Nodes.Workstation_M3Max` paired with `Models.Language.Llama3_8B`.

### `Agents.Research`
- `OrchestratorWorker`: Breadth-first orchestrator-worker research workload (20-turn horizon, 100 untrusted reads/task, 15× fan-out token multiple, 4× single-agent token multiple, $\sigma = 0.10$, $\kappa = 0.002$).

### `Agents.Remediation`
- `OnCall`: On-call production remediation workload (10-turn horizon, 2 requests/hour arrival rate, 15-minute approval decision window, 80% canary catch rate).

### `Agents.Support`
- `CustomerOps`: High-throughput customer-support workload (6-turn horizon, 8,192-token session context with 6,144-token shared prefix, 2 s generation residence, 20 s customer reply time).

### `Agents.Platforms` (`AgentPlatforms`)
- `Cloud_DGX_H100`: Enterprise cloud cluster execution envelope (SWE-bench harness on HGX H100 with dual 96-core EPYC CPUs and 8× H100 SXM5).
- `Workstation_Apple`: Local developer workstation envelope (SWE-bench harness on Apple M3 Max with 16 CPU cores and 128 GiB unified memory).

### `Agents.Deliberation`, `Agents.MultiAgent`, `Agents.Interactive`
- `Agents.Deliberation.TreeSearch`: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) deliberation agent with 8 branches, 64k context window, and PRM verification.
- `Agents.MultiAgent.SupervisorWorker`: Hierarchical multi-agent coordinator with 32k context window and coordination overhead parameter $\beta = 0.030$.
- `Agents.Interactive.StreamingVoice`: Speech-to-speech conversational pipeline with 8k context window and real-time latency budget.

## Python Usage

```python
from mlsysim import Agents

# Access Volume III lighthouse workloads
repair = Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Runner
research = Agents.Research.OrchestratorWorker
remediation = Agents.Remediation.OnCall
support = Agents.Support.CustomerOps
```
